2609.16884.title: Bridging Learned Visual Perception and Symbolic Belief-Space Planning
2609.16884.paper_summary: In partially observable settings, agents must act without full knowledge of the world state and rely on uncertain state-estimation pipelines. Obtaining grounded and verifiable symbolic plans under such uncertainty remains a key challenge. Recent work has integrated Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to bridge perception and symbolic reasoning, following two main paradigms. The first, VLM-as-planner, maps images directly to action sequences, and the second, VLM-as-grounder, grounds observations into symbolic predicates used as the initial state by off-the-shelf planners. Both approaches ignore uncertainty in the planning process, compromising robustness. We introduce a third paradigm, VLM-as-probabilistic-grounder, a novel approach that captures the uncertainty of VLM predicate groundings as a probability distribution over symbolic states. This enables planning in belief space and producing robust plans under uncertainty. Experiments in simulated household robot settings show improved robustness and task success over deterministic grounding, underscoring how our approach leverages foundation models for reliable planning under uncertainty.
2609.16884.paper_summary_zh: 在部分可觀察的環境中，代理必須在對世界狀態缺乏充分了解的情況下行動，並依賴不確定的狀態估計管道。在這種不確定性下獲得有根據且可驗證的符號計劃仍然是一個關鍵挑戰。最近的研究整合了視覺-語言模型（VLMs），以橋接感知和符號推理，遵循兩個主要範式。第一個，VLM作為規劃者，將圖像直接映射到動作序列；第二個，VLM作為基礎者，將觀察結果基於符號謂詞進行基礎化，這些謂詞被用作現成規劃者的初始狀態。這兩種方法在規劃過程中忽略了不確定性，妨礙了穩健性。我們提出第三種範式，VLM作為概率基礎者，這是一種新穎的方法，將VLM謂詞基礎化的不確定性捕捉為符號狀態上的概率分佈。這使得在信念空間中進行規劃並在不確定性下生成穩健的計劃成為可能。在模擬家庭機器人環境中的實驗顯示，相較於確定性基礎化，我們的方法在穩健性和任務成功率上有了改善，強調了我們的方法如何利用基礎模型在不確定性下進行可靠的規劃。
